exclusions.reason: Assigned to completeness agent; avoid duplicate table/advice extraction.
Chargen/career equipment catalogue screened; WIS/CON are inputs to shared check/inventory profiles, no regional map action from character generation.
Character reward progression beyond travel/map boundary; not required to create map or apply source travel procedure.
Illustrations/no substantive text in extraction.

Dungeon10minute turns, crawling/walking/running,torch/candle light and dungeon hazard die are site-interior gameplay; do not silently apply to regional hex movement. Retain site link/external dungeon-mode integration boundary.

Dungeon-room tables are optional linked content dependencies through structure/place-trait results; no autonomous regional layout procedure. Roots table resolver must permit referenced results rather than duplicate full room engine.
Retained as linked descriptive hazard content inKNAVE2-020; detailed trap simulation/room layout not inferred.
Combat10-second rounds noted for hazard integration; attack/manoeuvre/morale engine outside L1/L2, no separate full combat backlog.
Alcohol and generic spellbook mechanics outside primary map/hexcrawl pass; spell-dependent travel handled by other agent.
Illustrations do not state map/hexcrawl procedures; not converted into numeric generation rules.

All100 spell entries screened. Combat/mind-control/object tricks with no independent map/hexcrawl operation not each made a source requirement; applicable movement/weather/observation/spatial profiles retained. Full spellcasting/combat resolution remains integration boundary.
d12 new-spell-name formula is an optional L3 magic-content tool, not an independently required L1 regional generator. Names/table references included only where reached through linked data.
Blessing count, morning selection, favour and reward-strength resolution are L3 relic/character engine; retained as quest/rest dependency context, not compulsory map functions.
Full weapon/armour/animal/clothing price list, lifestyle/bribes and cargo bookkeeping are external character/economy inventory; settlement supply and logistics facts separately retained.

Property finance, construction pricing/upkeep and mass-battle resolution are independent domain/economy/combat systems; no source rule here specifies regional hex geometry, POI distribution or overland travel. Do not count them as missing L1 map functionality.

Carousing, gambling and career training are downtime/character development; source hooks from carousing point to already included missions/factions, but a carousing engine is not required for map/hexcrawl.
Individual monster combat effects, attacks, saves and damage are a bestiary integration boundary, not one map requirement per creature. Contextual number appearing and stat conventions are retained.

source_questions.issue: Stacking darkness+difficultterrain+badweather halving not specified; no silently chosen1/8 or single1/2.
Six-mile hex physical measurement convention unspecified.
Main text says less than80feet; quickref says within80feet. Keep exact boundary question.
Weather paragraph lightning3d6damage, hazard p21 says3d6directdamage; adoptedp21profile explicitly, main prose discrepancy recorded.
Quickref calls explore reveals secrets; core p8 separates discoverable places/clues from interaction-onlysecrets; do not grantautomaticsecretreveal.
Precise onset after2days/3days and recovery counter semantics requireconfirmation before strict automatedL3effects.
Spell INT token is any chosen value up to caster INT; numeric lower bound is not explicitly stated. All profiles use chosen_spell_level, not forced full characteristic.

Russian translation contains damaged/awkward relic-possession clause (visually checked); communicate-by-favour/relic conditions need original-edition check if automated. L1 patron/site association and shrine counts are clear.
City/town translation and scope of all patrons need explicit classification and finite known pantheon. Village count is usually1, not a hard global invariant.
Additional brewing watch gives+5, but repeated extra-watch stacking, portion yields and fixed crafting DC are not specified.
Harvesting a monster part costs10min; equal plant harvesting time is not stated.
Disaster labels such as river reversal are inspiration, not algorithmic licence to mutate existing geography with invented radii/durations.
